study: Exact user envelope; snapshot comparison before the official building gap-fill is integrated.
gapRule: An official whole footprint has no current OSM-derived building footprint at a distance of 3 m or less. This conservative spatial screen identifies clear absence; it is not the importer deduplication rule. Every source structure type and footprint area is included.
clusterRule: 250 m circles around retained OSM nodes explicitly tagged addr:suburb:en=Mui Wo. Representative-point inclusion. Circles overlap and are not official village boundaries; counts must not be added together.
